frozen_candidate_root_contribution: ftr marks the flagging / abatement / lapse that breaks a sustained continuity or maximal intensity — a relaxation OUT OF an already-running, uninterrupted state. It is realized derivationally across three forms of one root: Form I intransitive (the agent's own effort flags — 21:20 لَا يَفْتُرُونَ), Form II causative-passive (an intensity is made to ease off a patient — 43:75 لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ), and the verbal noun (the reified interval of such lapse in a continuous series — 5:19 فَتْرَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ). internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across its three Quranic occurrences the root ف ت ر consistently names a let-up in something that is (or should be) kept going without break. The angels 'do not yaftur' — they never slacken in ceaseless glorification (21:20). The punishment of hell 'is not yufattaru off them' — it is never made to ease or abate (43:75). And a messenger comes 'ʿalā fatratin' — during a gap/lull in the succession of messengers (5:19). Two of the three are under negation, so the positive sense (slackening) is asserted by what the negation denies; the noun is the one non-negated, realized instance of an actual lapse. The three sit in three unrelated domains (worship, torment, prophetic history) yet converge on one abstraction, which argues for a genuine unified nucleus rather than context-borrowing.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: ftr does NOT entail: (1) permanent termination or annihilation — a fatra is bounded and ended by resumption (فَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بَشِيرٌ), and لَا يَفْتُرُونَ negates a flagging otherwise conceivable within a continuum; (2) onset or content of an activity — the axis is maintenance/continuity of an already-running state, never its beginning or substance; (3) fixed moral valence — non-flagging is praise (angels), non-abatement is dread (torment), a fatra is a deprivation (messenger-gap); (4) physical fatigue as a property of the patient — in 43:75 Form II locates the (denied) easing in an external act ON the punishment (عَن), not in the punishment 'tiring'; (5) structural breakage/rupture of an object, or motion/splitting/creation — must not be conflated with the distinct root ف ط ر (fTr, with ṭāʾ).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 5:19 فَتْرَةٍ (N) is the category-shifter and the chief limiter on the grade: the two verbs denote a dynamic event (flagging / being abated) while the noun denotes a reified span of time ('a fatra of the messengers', partitive مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ). Reading it into the verbal nucleus requires the inferential step 'the interval IS the period during which the sending slackened' — a step no verse in the packet licenses, since there is no second nominal token to confirm it. The verse reads coherently on a flat temporal-sequence gap ('an interval between messengers') with the 'slackening' connotation supplied only externally. This is a candidate lexicalized/nominal sub-class, and per contract a nominal lexicalization risk caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE. (Resistance is mild rather than material: the verse's own logic — the pleadable excuse مَا جَآءَنَا مِن بَشِيرٍ وَلَا نَذِيرٍ presupposes a real break in continuity — keeps the noun inside the nucleus, which is why the class is flagged as an adversarial boundary, not a final-RESISTANT seam.)
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A flat single gloss 'to tire / rest / respite' (experiencer-centred). It fits 21:20 ('no rest') and 43:75 ('no respite') but under-generates: in 43:75 Form II is causative-passive with عَن ('be MADE to ease off'), and a punishment does not 'tire' — something eases it, so 'tire' mislocates the agency; and in 5:19 a fatra is not respite granted TO anyone but the ABSENCE of messenger-sending, a break in an external series with no rester. The 'abatement/interruption of a sustained state' nucleus covers all three more narrowly and without positing an experiencer, so it is preferred. A near-equivalent rival, 'interruption/intermittence of continuity', is folded in as the continuity-break facet of the same core (لَا يَفْتُرُونَ = no interruption, لَا يُفَتَّرُ = no respite, فَتْرَة = an interruption).

layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Domain-specific referents (angelic glorification never flagging; hellfire torment never eased; the historical gap in messenger-sending) are contextual applications and must NOT be promoted into the root claim; the root contributes only the abstract 'let-up of a sustained state', with the specific what-is-sustained supplied by context.
